start_here: Say to your AI: "Make the spans file to grade from my edit plans in /Work/demo/plans with the word files in /Work/demo/words, writing /Work/demo/spans.json." It runs tool:list-the-speech-in-my-edit-plans-to-grade on your computer and tells you how many stretches it listed.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads files on your computer and writes the spans file you name.
instructions: 1. Install python3 and clone the Workshop (git clone https://github.com/Trillion-X/trillion-workshop.git).

2. Your AI reads the row with tools:list and runs its run command on your computer: python3 trillion-workshop/tools/grade-and-repair-speech-audio/do-work/spans_from_plans.py --plans /Work/demo/plans --transcripts /Work/demo/words --out /Work/demo/spans.json
3. Pass the spans file to tool:grade-and-repair-speech-audio to grade and repair the speech in those stretches.

worked_examples.ask: Make the spans file from my two edit plans.
